name: My Son
provinceNote: The sanctuary’s address is Thôn Mỹ Sơn, xã Thu Bồn, Da Nang. UNESCO still gives Duy Phu Commune, Duy Xuyen District, Quang Nam.
dotReason: Worth it if you are already nearby
summary: The brick ruins of Cham temple towers in a forested valley, about 45 km from Hoi An. Walk among towers built by the Champa kingdom between the 4th and 13th centuries, visit the museum at the gate, and catch a traditional performance. Go in the morning from Hoi An; it suits history and architecture fans.
fee: Ticket information page and 2026 city list: 150,000 VND for a foreign adult; 100,000 VND for a Vietnamese adult. Purchase page on 21 Oct 2026: 148,000 VND and 99,000 VND. Child fare: Check on arrival.
getThere: 45 km by road from Hoi An. 68 km from Da Nang city. Minutes: Check on arrival. Road from Da Nang airport to the gate: Check on arrival. Tourism bus 01DL, Hoi An to My Son to Cong Troi Dong Giang, is paused for six months from 15 Sep 2026. No replacement is named. Cars stop at the museum. The electric cart does the last about 2 km, included in the entrance ticket in the 2020 visitor guide. Southbound train SE10 stops at Ga Tra Kieu. The road from that station to the gate: Check on arrival. The 20 km figure is to the old citadel of Tra Kieu, not a timed ride from the platform. Close: 17:00 on a 2019 notice. Live ticket site: tickets sold until 17:30, visiting ends at 18:00. Tower counts: a 25 Feb 2025 management essay, about 20 towers remain, and tower A1, once 24 meters, came down in a 1969 bombing. UNESCO inscription: eight groups and 71 monuments.
seoTitle: My Son travel guide — UNESCO Cham temple ruins
seoDescription: UNESCO Cham temple ruins in a forested valley, a morning from Hoi An. Walk the brick towers, start at the museum, and catch a daytime performance.
intro: You stand among UNESCO Cham temple ruins: brick towers in a closed basin, forest at the foot of the walls and a ring of hills behind, the religious center of the Champa kingdom from the 4th century to the 13th. Sleep in Hoi An if the old town is the night you wanted. Come out here if the Cham towers are the morning. Sleep in Da Nang only if that city is already the hotel.

Start at the museum beside the Khe Thẻ stream, then take the electric cart. The ride is about 2 km and is included in the entrance ticket on the 2020 visitor guide. The towers you are most likely to find standing are in groups B, C, and D. Walk what the board has open. Do not climb the brick, and do not eat inside the monument area. Stay on the paths. Unidentified unexploded ordnance is still recorded in the buffer zone.

The daytime Cham clock is part of the visit. Hall slots run at 09:45, 10:30, 11:15, 14:00, and 16:00. Group G is at 09:00 and 14:45, and bad weather can stop that show. On the 15th of the month, Echoes of My Son is in groups B, C, and D at 09:00 and 14:45. Đêm Mỹ Sơn huyền thoại is an evening show inside the grounds, and the calendar is not fixed. Do not stay for a night you have not confirmed. Two closing times are published. Come early and use the earlier one unless the gate tells you otherwise.
gettingAround: There is no walk from Hoi An and no train into the valley. Hire a car. The distances are 45 km from Hoi An and 68 km from Da Nang city. Cars stop at the museum. The electric cart does the last 2 km. One southbound train, SE10, stops at Ga Tra Kieu. The 20 km figure is the old citadel of Tra Kieu, not a timed ride from the platform.

stayAreas.name: Hoi An
stayAreas.summary: Sleep in the old town. My Son is the morning out, 45 km by road, and the valley is not where the evening is.

stayAreas.name: Da Nang
stayAreas.summary: Sleep here if the airport or the beach is already your night. The city is 68 km from the sanctuary.

eat: Eat before the gate. The ticket rules forbid food inside the monument. Around the valley are mì Quảng, bê thui Cầu Mống, mắm cái, a herring salad, and veal.
interestsBody: The UNESCO brick in the valley is the reason to come. Groups B, C, and D are where most of the remaining towers stand. The museum at the gate is the start, beside the Khe Thẻ stream, before the cart.

Daytime Cham performances run in the hall, at group G, and, on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, at the group H slope. Echoes of My Son is the 15th, in groups B, C, and D. The evening show has no fixed date.
Sleep in Hoi An, 45 km back. The ticket rules forbid eating in the monument area.

season.label: Rains from October
season.note: January to September is the dry stretch, and October to December is rainy, with floods usual in September to November and storms mainly September to December. Flooding and high humidity reach the sanctuary. This is not a closure notice. If the road is shut, check that morning.

faqs.q: Should you stay the night at My Son?
faqs.a: No. Sleep in Hoi An, or in Da Nang if that is already the hotel. The sanctuary is 45 km from Hoi An. The published close is 17:00, and also 18:00, with tickets sold until 17:30. Use the earlier time unless the gate tells you otherwise.

faqs.q: Is the bus from Hoi An running?
faqs.a: Tourism bus 01DL is paused for six months from 15 Sep 2026. No replacement is named. Come by road.

A foreign adult is 150,000 VND on the ticket page and the 2026 city list, and 148,000 VND on the purchase page on 21 Oct 2026. A Vietnamese adult is 100,000 VND, and 99,000 VND on that same purchase page. Read the amount before you pay. Ask the child fare at the gate.
